sentence: This project studies how river flow, rainfall and coastal sea level together cause floods and how their links change over time.
This project uses deep learning to speed up the analysis of gravitational waves from black holes and neutron stars.
This project organizes a meeting where robotics researchers share their research and ideas with each other.
This project tries to remove trapped oxygen from calcium lanthanum sulfide, a material that lets infrared light through.
This project builds garment-like wearable robots for the prevention and rehabilitation of musculoskeletal disorders in the upper extremity.
This project studies how plants that cannot photosynthesize have changed the protein translation machinery in their mitochondria and chloroplasts.
This project develops a framework that measures how much trust to place in machine learning agents that work together on different tasks.
This project runs workshops that show researchers how to use high-performance computing, datasets and AI tools for cybersecurity and autonomous driving.
This project studies how cells and organisms make decisions through signal transduction, using bacteria, yeast, plants, mice and human cells.
This project studies universal patterns in the solutions of nonlinear wave equations and random matrices, even in the presence of randomness.
This project studies how the cell size of mixotrophic plankton affects their metabolism as the ocean warms.
This project searches for chiral semiconductors and tries to make them with an excess of one of their two mirror image forms.
This project studies topics in biology and biochemistry, such as protein structure, snake ecology, cell migration and marine ecology, using data tools.
This project builds tools to calculate how atomic nuclei and nuclear matter behave, using machine learning to accelerate the calculations.
This project studies how echolocating bats change their calls when flying in groups with other bats.
